ActionInvokeIn.description:
`POST .../ontologies/{id}/actions/{key}/invoke` (contract section 4). `workspace` /
`project` (slugs) are needed only when the ontology is not project-scoped.
ActionInvokeIn.title: ActionInvokeIn

BoundGroupOut.description:
What a client sees of a platform group bound in it (B-930): id and name, and the
group's bindings in this client. Never its members, slug, status or IdP mapping.
BoundGroupOut.title: BoundGroupOut

BudgetPatch.description:
`scope` and `metric` are accepted so a client may echo the whole budget back, but they are
immutable: a different value is refused (delete / recreate to change what a budget measures).
BudgetPatch.title: BudgetPatch

CaptureContentPut.description: The client's own `capture_content` setting; `null` unsets it (the environment default).
CaptureContentPut.title: CaptureContentPut

Case.description:
`input`: `{"message": "..."}` (an agent's input text) or any object (an agent's input as
canonical JSON text, a pipeline's params).
Case.title: Case

CaseResult.description: One case's score; never the case's output text.
CaseResult.title: CaseResult

ContextPlan.description: The job's plan as the executor needs it; the sealed fields are `None` before sealing.
ContextPlan.title: ContextPlan

CredentialGrant.description: What the executor may fetch a credential for; it never holds a secret.
CredentialGrant.title: CredentialGrant

CredentialIssued.description: Issue and rotate: the full `shx_` token, shown once.
CredentialIssued.title: CredentialIssued

CredentialOut.description: Never the secret or its hash: the secret exists only in `CredentialIssued`.
CredentialOut.title: CredentialOut

DeploymentDetail.description: The item GET only: the deployment with its journal, ordered by `recorded_at`.
DeploymentDetail.title: DeploymentDetail

DeploymentMarkFailed.description: Mark an unknown outcome failed: a note (1-2000 characters after stripping) is required.
DeploymentMarkFailed.title: DeploymentMarkFailed

Diagnostic.description: One feature of the compatibility check; `reason` is null when it is supported.
Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

EntrypointOut.description: `version_id` and `spec_hash` are null for a version the caller cannot see.
EntrypointOut.title: EntrypointOut

EnvironmentBindings.description: Keys are pin names: a model id (or `route-<route id>`) and a connection id.
EnvironmentBindings.title: EnvironmentBindings

EvaluationRequest.description: `{}`: the dataset and thresholds come from the release's manifest.
EvaluationRequest.title: EvaluationRequest

EvaluationRunOut.description:
`accuracy` and `total_cost_usd` are decimal strings; result fields are null until the
evaluation is scored.
EvaluationRunOut.title: EvaluationRunOut

GroupBindingCreate.description: A platform group bound in a client by the platform administrator (B-1602).
GroupBindingCreate.title: GroupBindingCreate

GroupCreate.description:
A platform group (platform administrator only). `idp_config_id` and `external_id`
together map an external IdP group name onto it (`source = 'idp'`, installation IdP only).
GroupCreate.title: GroupCreate

GroupRef.description: A group bound in this client that the person is in: id and name only (B-930).
GroupRef.title: GroupRef

JobContext.description: What a leased job runs against (never a credential, the claim or the artifact bytes).
JobContext.title: JobContext

JournalEntry.description: One journal step: the intent is recorded before the native write, the receipt after it.
JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry

JsonAssertion.description: The output text parses as JSON and equals `value`.
JsonAssertion.title: JsonAssertion

LeaseProof.description: The current lease of a job; every per-job gateway call proves it.
LeaseProof.title: LeaseProof

NodeOut.description: One node of a pipeline run (P6 section 4, amendment E1).
NodeOut.title: NodeOut

OrgSummaryOut.description:
One entry of an organization list: what the client chooser needs, nothing the client
wrote about itself.
OrgSummaryOut.title: OrgSummaryOut

OwnedResource.description: A native resource the job's target and application key already own.
OwnedResource.title: OwnedResource

PlanApprove.description: The approver quotes the sealed digest they reviewed.
PlanApprove.title: PlanApprove

PlanCreate.description:
Settled call 17: the target, the application's slug and its display name; SP3 settled
call 3: the sealed release it deploys.
PlanCreate.title: PlanCreate

PlanOut.description:
A plan; `release_id`, `release_digest` and `evaluation_run_id` are null unless the caller
can read the plan's release.
PlanOut.title: PlanOut

PolicyIn.description: Create / full replace (PATCH takes the whole body + `row_version`, amendment F1).
PolicyIn.title: PolicyIn

PolicyPatch.description: `kind` and `scope` may be echoed back but cannot change.
PolicyPatch.title: PolicyPatch

Problem.description: OpenAPI schema of every error response.
Problem.title: Problem

QuotaPatch.description: `scope` and `metric` may be echoed back but cannot change.
QuotaPatch.title: QuotaPatch

RegexAssertion.description: The whole output text matches `value` (Python `re`, full match, 1 s budget).
RegexAssertion.title: RegexAssertion

ReleaseOut.description: A release; pins and tool paths of versions the caller cannot see are redacted.
ReleaseOut.title: ReleaseOut

SecretOut.description: Metadata only: never the value, ciphertext or key material (B-803).
SecretOut.title: SecretOut

ShiAccessOut.description:
A client's own switch for the SHI provider (shown to its owner). Who changed it is a
platform administrator, not a person of the client: the client's audit trail names them.
ShiAccessOut.title: ShiAccessOut

ShiProviderPut.description:
The platform administrator creates (first PUT) or changes the shared SHI provider. It has
no settings: SHI's endpoint and key reference are installation configuration (B-1712).
ShiProviderPut.title: ShiProviderPut

SolutionPinOut.description: `version_id` and `spec_hash` are null for a version the caller cannot see.
SolutionPinOut.title: SolutionPinOut

TestJobOut.description: A queued connection test (ARCH M2): `result` once the worker has recorded it.
TestJobOut.title: TestJobOut

TextAssertion.description:
`equals`: the output text equals `value`; `contains` / `not_contains`: case-sensitive
substring.
TextAssertion.title: TextAssertion
